title: Related Questions

Early Zakat (Before it's due date) 2302 views Q. If a person belonging to syed family wants to give his zakat to his relative who is also a syed. I think zakat should not be given to a syed family person. Hence, he has decided to give his zakat to a non-syed person and get back the zakat amount from him as gift. Then he handed over the gift amount to his syed relative. Is it correct procedure. pl. clarify. 3581 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 47502 Country: India Title: ZAKAAT TO SAYED relative(Mammu) Question: I would like to know, as I heard that it is best to give zakah to your relative. I also heard that we cannot give zakah to a Sayyid. My relative is Sayyid. Can I give zakah to him? Since I have limited money for zakah, if I give him just for charity then I will not have money to pay the zakah. Answer ID: 47502 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1322/H-316/TH=10/1434) In this case also, it is not right to pay zakah. Their respect and honour demand that they should be supported with gift money instead of zakah though you have to cut short your expenses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
